name: realPairWeil_fockLetters
summary: Unfold the action of realPairWeil on Fock vectors of polynomials and the two algebra maps; the two sums agree after exchanging the order of summation.

steps.claim: By the formula for realPairWeil on Fock vectors of polynomials, with first weight negCount(s), (1, y) acts by substituting y^T in the variables of sign 1 and y^(-1) in those of sign -1; unfold fockLetters and rowSubst on both sides.
Both sides are the same double sum up to the order of summation.
